title: Correct angular velocity
description: Essential Criteria: The student correctly converts the rotational speed to angular velocity (ω = 20π rad/s).

title: Instantaneous EMF expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student provides the correct sinusoidal expression for the instantaneous EMF (e.g., 100 sin(20πt) V).

title: Instantaneous EMF value
description: Essential Criteria: The student calculates the correct instantaneous EMF at t=1/60 s (e.g., 50√3 V).

title: Average EMF value
description: Essential Criteria: The student calculates the correct average EMF from t=0 to t=1/60 s (e.g., 150/π V).

title: Application of Faraday's Law
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly applies Faraday's law (E_avg = N ΔΦ/Δt) for the average EMF calculation.

title: Magnetic flux change calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly determines the change in magnetic flux (ΔΦ) over the specified time interval.

title: Correct initial condition
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly interprets the initial condition (t=0 at neutral plane) to determine the phase of the sinusoidal EMF.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student maintains consistent units throughout the solution and presents final answers with correct units.

title: Sign or phase error
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student uses cosine instead of sine, or introduces an incorrect phase shift, for the instantaneous EMF expression.

title: Incorrect angular frequency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student makes an error in converting rotational speed to angular frequency (e.g., forgetting the 2π factor).
